paragraphs: The Kona is the Mapuche unique cavalry unit in Age of Empires. A mounted warrior with a long lance, it brings speed and close combat pressure to an army built around cavalry and counter units.
Infantry and foot archers are natural targets, while spearmen, camel riders and monks can threaten its advance.
The Kona deals increasing damage to enemies that are already injured. As a target loses health, the rider becomes more dangerous, making it particularly effective at finishing a wounded opponent.
Mapuche mounted units also earn gold when they defeat military enemies. Here, the elite rider must turn its finishing power into victory with a fixed army.
